{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Number of rows per patient:")
print(df.groupby('patient_id').size().value_counts())

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# This ensures we keep the most recent test for each patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")"}
